shell.library_prepare_failed: Could not prepare the library folder: {{.Error}}
shell.userdata_recovered: User data was damaged and has been saved to the backup {{.File}} next to it. New user data has been created.
shell.write_access.title: Write access needed
shell.write_access.text: Choose the library folder again and allow access - the app will remember read and write access. It is needed to save downloads and delete files.
library.read_failed: Could not read the library folder: {{.Error}}
library.new_errors: New errors: {{.Count}} - see the Errors tab
library.empty.title: The library is empty
library.empty.hint: Copy .zip archives to the library folder:
library.choose.title: Choose a manga folder
library.choose.hint: Choose or create a folder inside Download, for example Download/manga, and put .zip archives there. The app will see everything in this folder.
search.help.title: How to search
search.help.word: part of a word in the title, tags, scanlator, file name, ID
search.help.typed_tag: tag of a type: artist, group, parody, character, language, category
search.help.custom_tag: your own tag (added on the work page)
search.help.hidden_tag: original tag you hid on the work page
search.help.missing: no tag of the type (artist, language, ...), tags, or meta: missing:meta (no meta.json)
search.help.combined: everything together: conditions are combined with AND
search.reason.id_exact_only: id supports only an exact value
search.reason.bad_size: expected a size like 10mb, 1,5gb or 500k, got “{{.A}}”
search.reason.bad_date: expected a date YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, got “{{.A}}”
search.reason.op_not_allowed: operation “{{.A}}” is not allowed for field {{.B}}
search.reason.bad_date_range: invalid date range: the start is after the end
search.reason.unknown_value: unknown value “{{.A}}”: expected a tag type, tags or meta
problem.image: Image - only zip, RAR and 7z archives are supported
problem.video: Video - only zip, RAR and 7z archives are supported
problem.audio: Audio - only zip, RAR and 7z archives are supported
problem.pdf: PDF - only zip, RAR and 7z archives are supported
problem.other_archive: RAR/7z archive - could not be read
problem.text: Text file - only zip, RAR and 7z archives are supported
problem.html: Web page (HTML) instead of an archive - the site probably returned an error or a check page
problem.not_zip: not a valid archive or the archive is damaged
error.busy: The file is in use by another program
error.browser_unsupported: The built-in browser is unavailable on this platform
error.no_write_access: No write access to the library folder
error.no_trash: This drive has no Recycle Bin
error.tag_invalid: Tag name: 1 to {{.Max}} characters, no " quotes
actions.show_in_folder_failed: Could not show the file in its folder: {{.Error}}
actions.delete.title: Delete this work?
actions.delete.to_trash: Move it to the Recycle Bin?
actions.delete.no_trash: The Recycle Bin is not available. Delete permanently?
actions.delete.permanent: The file will be deleted permanently
actions.delete.in_use: The work is open in the reader - close it and try again
tags.reset.title: Reset tags?
tags.reset.text: Your tags: {{.Custom}}, hidden: {{.Hidden}}. Your tags will be removed and hidden ones shown again.
reader.end_hint: End of the work. Turn the page again to close
reader.position_approx: The archive has changed, the position may be inaccurate
settings.library.title: Library folder
settings.library.hint: Choose or create a folder inside Download, for example Download/manga, and put archives there. Android does not allow choosing the Download root.
settings.covers.clear_failed: Could not clear the cover cache: {{.Error}}
settings.covers.hint: Reduced covers on disk, in the app cache (Android shows it as "Cache"). After clearing they are created again from the archives as cards are shown.
settings.about.title: About
settings.search.title: Search
settings.search.hint: While typing - search 0.5 s after you stop typing; on button - with the search button or Enter.
settings.random.title: Random pick
settings.random.hint: The dice button in the library and search opens a random work. No repeats - a work won't come up again until all the others have.
sort.title: Title
settings.sort.title: Sorting
settings.sort.hint: Default order of the library and search at launch. The order you pick above the grid lasts until the app is closed.
settings.reader.title: Reader
settings.reader.hint: Right to left swaps the tap zones, swipes and the ← → keys and flips the slider. The mouse wheel, PgUp/PgDn and the strip mode stay the same.
settings.reader.double_tap_hint: The zoom a double tap enlarges the page to; another double tap returns to 100%. With double tap off, taps turn pages right away without waiting for a second tap.
settings.grid.title: Grid
settings.grid.columns_hint: How many cards fit in a row in the library and search when the phone is upright. When it is sideways, the cards keep their size and more fit in a row.
settings.grid.size_hint: Card size in the library and search; the number of columns depends on the window width.
settings.display.title: Display
settings.display.hint: Saves battery: on a screen faster than 60 Hz the app asks for 60 Hz. Scrolling stays even, with fewer frames.
settings.userdata.title: Data retention
settings.userdata.days_invalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {{.Max}}
settings.userdata.hint: Your data about a work whose file is not found (deleted or moved out of the library folder) is kept for this period: if the file comes back, the data comes back too. Data of works not found for longer is deleted.
settings.language.title: Язык / Language
settings.language.restart: The language will change after the app restarts.
browser.title: Browser
browser.note: Built-in Firefox; downloads are saved to the library folder
browser.home_invalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
browser.restart: Changes take effect after the browser restarts
browser.clear_cookies.text_desktop: You will be signed out of websites. History and bookmarks will be kept.
browser.clear_cookies.text_mobile: You will be signed out of websites. Bookmarks and extensions will be kept.
browser.clear_history.text_desktop: Browsing and download history and form data will be deleted. Bookmarks and cookies will be kept.
browser.clear_history.text_mobile: Tab history and the download list will be deleted. Bookmarks, extensions and cookies will be kept.
browser.clear_later: Will be cleared the next time the browser opens
browser.close.title: Close the browser?
browser.close.text: Clearing will happen the next time the browser opens. Close it now?
dev.title: Development
dev.hint: The tests scroll the app by themselves for about 3 minutes — don't touch the screen. Reports are saved to {{.Dir}}
dev.recording: Recording frames — scroll the app yourself, then stop
stats.all_hidden: All blocks are hidden. Turn them on in “Customize”.
stats.forever.title: Permanent exclusion
stats.forever.text: Move {{.Tag}} to the permanent exclusions of the "{{.Block}}" block? Manage them in Customize.
stats.config.title: Statistics settings
stats.config.pages_bounds: Page count bounds, comma separated (for example 20, 50, 100)
stats.config.size_bounds: File size bounds in MB, comma separated; decimals with a dot (for example 2.5, 10)
